tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content. Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (5.0:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: bg-secondary
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.data-table tbody tr:nth-child(2n)`.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Primary actions, highlights, brand elements. Used as text on `.main-nav a:hover`, `.stat-number`, `.card-subtitle`. 3.6:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: color-primary-dark
tokens.usage: Primary brand colour: key actions and emphasis.

tokens.name: color-primary-light
tokens.usage: Used as text on `.footer-section h3`. 2.5:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Structure, data, technical information. Used as text on `.btn-secondary`. 8.8:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-charcoal
tokens.usage: Used as text on `body`, `.logo-text h1`, `.main-nav a`. 10.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: color-cream
tokens.usage: Used as background on `.data-table tbody tr:nth-child(2n)`.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: color-error
tokens.usage: Error / danger state; pair with a label or icon.

tokens.name: social-icon-bg
tokens.usage: Painted directly by the reference page: text on `.footer-section p, .footer-section a`, `.footer-bottom`, `.category-tag`; background on `.social-icon`, `.category-tag`; border on `.category-tag`. 1.1:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.
